Govt ITI Sonpur Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Govt ITI Sonpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the Govt ITI Sonpur recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the recruitment is Guest Instructor. There are 5 vacancies available for this position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person.

faq.question: Q3. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 25 August 2026. Candidates should report at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the Guest Instructor post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Degree/Diploma in relevant Engineering with experience, or NTC/NAC in a relevant trade with experience.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies for the Guest Instructor post.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: You should carry original documents and self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for this position is Contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Government Industrial Training Institute Sonpur located?
faq.answer: The institute is located in Sonpur, Odisha, with the pincode 767062.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is 1046/Dt. 12/08/2026.
